sessions.title: Opening Remarks
sessions.desc: A warm welcome from the First AI Summit team. We’ll walk you through the three days ahead—the speakers, the sessions, and the moments worth showing up for.

sessions.title: Keynote: Shaping the Future with AI
sessions.desc: Our keynote speaker opens the event with a bold vision of where AI is heading — the shifts already happening and what’s coming next.

sessions.title: Panel: The State of AI in 2026
sessions.desc: Top founders and researchers explore where AI truly stands today — beyond the hype, beyond the headlines.

sessions.title: Workshop: Building AI-First Products
sessions.desc: A hands-on session focused on turning ideas into AI-powered products. Learn how to design, build, and launch scalable solutions using modern AI tools.

sessions.title: Talk: Designing Human-Centered AI
sessions.desc: Explore how to create AI experiences that feel intuitive, ethical, and user-first — balancing technology with real human needs.

sessions.title: Case Study: Scaling AI in Real-World Systems
sessions.desc: A deep dive into how companies are successfully integrating AI into real-world products — challenges, learnings, and outcomes.

sessions.title: Talk: The Next Era of AI Innovation
sessions.desc: Explore what’s next for AI — from emerging breakthroughs to the long-term impact on industries, creativity, and everyday life.

sessions.title: Workshop: From Idea to AI Startup
sessions.desc: Learn how to turn your AI ideas into real startups — covering validation, product building, and go-to-market strategies.

sessions.title: Fireside Chat: Building in the Age of AI
sessions.desc: An honest conversation with industry leaders on lessons, failures, and opportunities while building in the AI-driven world.

faq.q: What is this AI conference about?
faq.a: This is a three-day AI conference focused on innovation, design, and real-world applications. It brings together industry leaders, creators, and professionals to explore how AI is transforming products, businesses, and everyday experiences through talks, panels, and hands-on sessions.

This event is designed for designers, developers, founders, product managers, and anyone curious about AI. Whether you're just starting out or already working in the field, you'll find valuable insights, practical knowledge, and meaningful connections.

Yes, all major sessions including keynotes, panels, and selected workshops will be recorded. Recordings will be available to Pro and VIP pass holders after the event so you can revisit key learnings anytime.

faq.q: Do I need prior AI knowledge?
faq.a: No prior experience is required. The conference is structured to cater to all levels, with beginner-friendly sessions as well as advanced discussions for professionals already working with AI.

faq.q: Can I upgrade my ticket later?
faq.a: Yes, you can upgrade your ticket before the event, subject to availability and payment of the price difference.
Absolutely. The event includes dedicated networking sessions, informal meetups, and open interaction spaces where you can connect with speakers, founders, and fellow attendees.
Yes, refunds are available within a limited time after purchase. Please check the event policy for specific timelines and eligibility details.
